A brick pathway winds through the greenery, leading to a stone and glass structure with arched doorways visible in the background. The greenhouse's curved glass roof and metal framework allow soft, diffused light to fill the interior. Wooden benches are placed among the plants, offering places to rest and enjoy the scenery. candidats.titre: File:Log Cabin Association Elementary School, Barkers Creek, NC (46649144171).jpg
candidats.description: This is the old Log Cabin Association Consolidated School, located atop a knoll overlooking US 74-441 at the community of Barker’s Creek, near Dillsboro, North Carolina. The building was one of three elementary schools constructed between 1949 and 1952, which consolidated the last remaining rural wood-frame one-room and two-room schools in the county, with the other two schools, with similar designs, being located at the communities Addie (Scott’s Creek Township) and Argura/Sols Creek (Canada Township).
